maddeler.e:
انكمشت (form VII)
# اِنْكَمَشْتُ (inkamaštu) /in.ka.maʃ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# اِنْكَمَشْتَ (inkamašta) /in.ka.maʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# اِنْكَمَشْتِ (inkamašti) /in.ka.maʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# اِنْكَمَشَتْ (inkamašat) /in.ka.ma.ʃat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
